images.caption:
The San Bernardino National Forest contracted GE Forestry, a forestry service company out of Medford, Oregon, to assist in a planting project on the Mountaintop Ranger District after the wake of the 2015 Lake Fire, which torched 31,359 acres of timber and vegetation. . 

As of the summer of 2017, the project has completed a total of 1,009 acres of national forest land with GE Forestry and the U.S. Forest Service successfully planting 175,772 tree seedlings along forest service roads 1N78 and 1N05 located just north of Highway 38 near Barton Flats Campground. Planting will continue in the spring of 2018 with an additional 1,000 acres added to the project. (USDA photos by Kyle Silva)
